name: utility-saathi
description: Utility Saathi: unified electricity and water service management (hackathon prototype)

scripts.setup: npm install && npm --prefix server install && npm --prefix client install
scripts.dev: concurrently -n api,web -c cyan,magenta "npm --prefix server run dev" "npm --prefix client run dev"
scripts.start: npm run build && npm --prefix server start
scripts.typecheck: npm --prefix server run typecheck && npx --prefix client tsc --noEmit -p client
